Na estimação em duas etapas, o CRM é aju: In two-step estimation, the CRM is first adjusted to the transformed continuous responses. The conditional independence of the items allows combining their individual contributions and integrating the latent trait, usually assumed as standard normal, to obtain the marginal likelihood of the discrimination, difficulty and scale parameters (ZXQKEEP000QXZ). As this integration makes direct maximization difficult, the Expectation-Maximization algorithm treats the trace as unobserved data: in the expectation step, it calculates the conditional quantities necessary under the current parameters; in the maximization step, it updates the item parameters. Thus, the uncertainty about each ZXQKEEP000QXZ is propagated to the estimation of the regression coefficients, instead of being discarded between two steps (ZXQKEEP001QXZ; ZXQKEEP002QXZ).

O tipo de método empregado para modelar: The type of method used to model latent variables depends on whether the construct is on a continuous scale, or is divided into latent classes. Likewise, the nature of the indicators, whether continuous or categorical, also influences the choice of methodology used. One of the approaches used in the literature is Item Response Theory (IRT), which models the relationship between a latent trait on a continuous scale and the probability of an individual obtaining a certain result on a test (ZXQKEEP000QXZ). Despite the wide use of IRT in the psychometric or educational assessment context, IRT has a multidisciplinary character and can be applied in the most diverse areas of knowledge (ZXQKEEP001QXZ; ZXQKEEP002QXZ; ZXQKEEP003QXZ).

Subsequently, ZXQKEEP003QXZ extended the dichotomous approach to polytomous items with the Graded Response Models (GRM), modeling the probability of an individual responding to a given ordinal category of a test. From this, other approaches to categorical responses were formulated, such as the Model for Nominal Responses (ZXQKEEP004QXZ), the Gradual Scale Model (ZXQKEEP005QXZ) and the Partial Credit Model (ZXQKEEP006QXZ; ZXQKEEP007QXZ).
